[Required] facility_name: Exact facility/region name from Manage Data → Regions. Required.
[Required] process_type: combustion | flaring | venting | blowdown | pneumatic | tank_flashing | tank_working | tank_breathing | drilling | completions | unloading | agr | dehydrator | fugitive | mobile | indirect_steam | stoichiometry | separation
[Required] fuel: Fuel or activity type exactly as in API factors catalog (e.g. Natural Gas, Diesel, Associated Gas). Required for Tier 1.
[Required] quantity: Numeric activity quantity (volume, mass, count, etc.). Required.
[Required] unit: Unit of quantity: m3 | scf | mscf | mmscf | bbl | gal | l | kg | tonne | lb | kWh. Required.
[Required] factor_type: default = API standard factors (Tier 1) | custom = user-saved factor | specific = engineering/Tier 3 calculation
[Optional] activity: Activity label (e.g. Exploration & Production). Defaults to facility activity if blank.
[Optional] region: Region label. Defaults to facility region if blank.
[Optional] division: Division label. Defaults to facility division if blank.
[Optional] field: Field/sub-unit name. Defaults to facility field if blank.
[Optional] group: Emission source group (e.g. Compressor Station A). For reporting grouping only.
[Optional] equipment: Equipment tag/ID (e.g. EQ-001). Used for duplicate detection.
